svg.title: TouchMe - back view, labelled
svg.desc: The back of the Playtronica TouchMe: two KEY touch rings and two SCALE touch rings, a row of note names C to B showing the current key, and a row of twelve scale symbols showing the current scale.
svg.text: tap to move the root note
tap to step through the 12 scales
Key row — note names C to B
Scale row — one symbol per scale
